notes.purpose: M17 step 3: isolate the contribution of each ingredient (06 S12). Every variant changes only the objective or the feasible set used for CHOOSING; the runner always scores the returned assignment with the full, true evaluate().
notes.scales: s = 1 is the measured/stated traffic. The second point should be the crossover neighbourhood from M15, but M15 and M16 found NO crossover anywhere in [0.01, 100] on T1-T3, so there is no such neighbourhood; s = 100 is used instead as the egress-heaviest end of the frozen M15 range, where coupling has the best chance of mattering (D-072). The range itself is unchanged, so this is not a threshold change.
notes.draws: the same R = 30 draws as results/replicates (seed = 10,000 + draw_id, 05 S3), so every ablation is paired with the M16 rows draw by draw.
notes.decomposition: b1 -> b1_storage -> ilp_no_edge_egress -> ilp_full telescopes to C(B1) - C(ILP) per draw; asserted in tests/test_ablations.py (A1).
notes.sa_variants: sa_random_init drops the greedy start, sa_no_swap sets p_relocate = 1.0 so swap moves are never proposed (D-071). Both use the same 5 seeds as M16; the drawn value of a method is the median over its seeds (D-068).
notes.ilp_mccormick: included as the runtime-only ablation: the objective must be identical to ilp_full (asserted in tests).

notes.runs.csv: one row per (instance, method, seed); standard columns (01 §4) first; appended as each job finishes; resume skips present keys.
notes.runtime_s: method wall time; ILP = build + CBC; greedy_1opt includes greedy.
notes.status: optimal (ILP proven) | feasible (ILP incumbent, not proven) | no_solution | ok (heuristic or baseline)
